exercises.question: Which change is correct? [¿Qué cambio es correcto?]
options: «Vivo aquí» → Dijo que vivía allí. [“I live here” → He said that he lived there.]
«Vivo aquí» → Dijo que vivo aquí. [“I live here” → He said that I live here.]
«Vivo aquí» → Dijo que vivirá allí. [“I live here” → He said that he would live there.]

exercises.question: Which word means «perspective»? [¿Qué palabra significa «perspectiva»?]
options: perspectiva [perspective]
conversación [conversation]
respuesta [answer]

exercises.english: Each witness had a different perspective.

options: “I live here” → He said that he lived there.
“I lived there” → He said that he lives here.
“I live here” → He asked if I lived there.

options: “I am going tomorrow” → He said that he was going the next day.

prompt.text: ¿Qué pasó con «aquí» al cambiar la perspectiva?

options: Se convirtió en «allí». [It became “there”.]
Se convirtió en «entonces». [It became “then”.]
No cambió nunca. [It never changed.]
Porque cambia la perspectiva del hablante. [Because the speaker's perspective changes.]
Porque no existe la conversación. [Because the conversation does not exist.]
Porque no cambia la perspectiva del hablante. [Because the speaker's perspective does not change.]

template.answer: Al cambiar la perspectiva, pueden cambiar los pronombres y las expresiones de tiempo y lugar.
